```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
## Load the data
```{r}
positions <- read_csv("data/raw/sea_2026-10-15_17utc.csv")
head(positions)
```
## Sanity Checks
```{r}
nrow(positions)
n_distinct(positions$icao24)
```
```{r}
n_distinct(positions$callsign)
max(positions$baroaltitude)
```
## All traffic
```{r}
library(leaflet)


leaflet(positions) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, radius = 1, stroke = FALSE,
                   fillOpacity = 0.5,
                   popup = ~paste(callsign, "-", round(baroaltitude), "m"))
```
## Arrivals Only
```{r}
# SEA Airport location
sea_lat <- 47.449
sea_lon <- -122.309

# One summary row per flight
flights <- positions |>
  arrange(icao24, time) |>
  group_by(icao24, callsign) |>
  summarise(
    start_alt = first(baroaltitude),
    end_alt = last(baroaltitude),
    end_lat = last(lat),
    end_lon = last(lon),
    n_points = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# IDs of the arriving aircraft
arrival_ids <- flights |>
  filter(end_alt < 1000,
         end_alt < start_alt,
         abs(end_lat - sea_lat) < 0.15,
         abs(end_lon - sea_lon) < 0.15) |>
  pull(icao24)
#All positions for just those aircraft
arrivals <- positions |>
  filter(icao24 %in% arrival_ids) |>
  arrange(icao24, time)

length(arrival_ids)
```
```{r}
# Turn between two headings, from -180 to 180 (handles 350 -> 10 = +20)
heading_change <- function(from, to) {
  ((to - from + 540) %% 360) - 180
}

turning <- arrivals |>
  group_by(icao24, callsign) |>
  mutate(turn = heading_change(lag(heading), heading)) |>
  summarise(
    total_turn = sum(abs(turn), na.rm = TRUE),
    minutes    = (max(time) - min(time)) / 60,
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total_turn))
head(turning, 10)
```
```{r}
pick <- "DAL868"

one <- arrivals |>
  filter(str_trim(callsign) == pick) |>
  arrange(time)

leaflet(one) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolylines(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, weight = 3, color = "red") |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = head(one, 1), lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
                   radius = 6, color = "green", label = "start") |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = tail(one, 1), lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
                   radius = 6, color = "black", label = "end")
```

## Detecting loops

A loop is about 360 degrees of turning in one direction, within 12 minutes, in an area under 30 km across. Wobbles cancel out because left and right turns have opposite signs.

```{r}
# Convert lat/lon to x/y in km around SEA (flat approximation, fine at this scale)
to_km <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(x = (lon - sea_lon) * 111.32 * cos(sea_lat * pi / 180),
           y = (lat - sea_lat) * 111.32)
}

find_loops <- function(flight, max_minutes = 12, max_size_km = 30) {
  flight <- flight |> arrange(time) |> to_km()
  turn <- heading_change(lag(flight$heading), flight$heading)
  turn[is.na(turn)] <- 0

  loops <- list()
  n <- nrow(flight)
  i <- 1

  while (i < n) {
    cumul <- 0
    found <- FALSE
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      if ((flight$time[j] - flight$time[i]) / 60 > max_minutes) break
      cumul <- cumul + turn[j]
      if (abs(cumul) >= 340) {
        found <- TRUE
        break
      }
    }

    if (found) {
      seg  <- flight[i:j, ]
      size <- max(max(seg$x) - min(seg$x), max(seg$y) - min(seg$y))
      if (size <= max_size_km) {
        spread <- eigen(cov(cbind(seg$x, seg$y)))$values
        loops[[length(loops) + 1]] <- tibble(
          start_time = flight$time[i],
          minutes    = (flight$time[j] - flight$time[i]) / 60,
          direction  = if_else(cumul > 0, "right", "left"),
          size_km    = size,
          elongation = sqrt(spread[1] / max(spread[2], 1e-6)),
          center_lat = mean(seg$lat),
          center_lon = mean(seg$lon)
        )
        i <- j + 1   # skip past this loop and keep looking
        next
      }
    }
    i <- i + 1
  }
  bind_rows(loops)
}

loops <- arrivals |>
  group_by(icao24, callsign) |>
  group_modify(~ find_loops(.x)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(type = if_else(elongation >= 2, "racetrack hold", "vectoring loop"))

loops
```

Every arrival in grey, with each detected loop marked by type.

```{r}
pal <- colorFactor(c("red", "orange"),
                   domain = c("racetrack hold", "vectoring loop"))

loop_map <- leaflet() |> addTiles()

for (id in arrival_ids) {
  flight <- filter(arrivals, icao24 == id)
  loop_map <- loop_map |>
    addPolylines(data = flight, lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
                 color = "grey", weight = 1, opacity = 0.5)
}

loop_map |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = loops, lng = ~center_lon, lat = ~center_lat,
                   color = ~pal(type), radius = 8, fillOpacity = 0.8,
                   label = ~paste(callsign, "-", type, "-",
                                  round(minutes, 1), "min")) |>
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = loops$type, title = "Loop type")
```
